_comment: Hand-curated entries not expressible as an @deprecated docblock. Every entry needs a change record URL and a deprecation notice checked in core source.

entries.replacement: Use the matching PHP attribute class on the plugin class, for example #[Block(id: ..., admin_label: ...)] from Drupal\Core\Block\Attribute\Block.
entries.notes: Core emits the deprecation at runtime from AttributeDiscoveryWithAnnotations since 11.2.0. Attributes were introduced in 10.2.0 and DefaultPluginManager prefers them over annotations since 11.2.0 (CR 3521588).

entries.replacement: Use classes (OOP hooks in the theme, services) instead of a procedural .theme file.
entries.notes: 11.5.0 is not yet released as of the as_of date; the version comes from the notice in core 12.0.0-beta2.

entries.symbol: 'file' and 'includes' keys in hook_theme() definitions, and template_preprocess_HOOK() functions in include files
entries.replacement: Use initial preprocess (a #[Hook] class method or a preprocess callback registered through the theme hook) instead of file/includes keys.

entries.symbol: Hook implementations autoloaded from include files (for example module.tokens.inc, via hook_hook_info())
entries.replacement: Move the functions into the .module file or into a #[Hook] class.
Use the core/once library and the once() function, for example once("my-behavior", ".selector", context).forEach(...).
entries.notes: The matching library entry is library:core/jquery.once. The change record was created for 9.2.0 when core/once was added; the library deprecation notice in core says 9.3.0.
